page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines of type; no margin notes. Top: the title in large capitals; below it the author line, dedication, and imprint. Bottom: the place name in spaced capitals. Handwritten marks (4028, a pencilled "(2)") and the digitiser's footer are not printed text and are left out.

main_text.l: Inseruimus etiam huic quosdam sales iu-

page.notes: The pencilled marks "4028" at the top and "(2)" at the upper right are handwriting and are not transcribed. The "Aᴬ" before IOANNE is a decorated capital A, transcribed as printed. Short line-end hyphens in the title and imprint are printed hyphens. "INDICE" in the imprint is shown in spaced capitals as printed; the last letter may be a worn or ligatured form, so it is marked for checking. The margins of the scan carry show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed.
